findings.reason: The active-execution fence inlines {"launching", "running"} although ACTIVE_EXECUTION_STATES is exported from lifecycle_authority, the module this change already imports from; reusing the constant keeps the fence tied to the registered definition. The same comprehension also calls .values() on state.get("executions") without an isinstance check, so a corrupt non-dict ledger raises AttributeError into _record_contained_fault instead of failing closed quietly.

_terminal_settled_predecessor is a terminal-authority lifecycle fence but lives in control_commands.py, which is not in CONTROL_PLANE_RUNTIME_SURFACES or _PROTECTED_PATH_STEMS, so future edits to it are not caught by declared_scope_gap. Consider hosting the predicate beside task_has_terminal_settlement in lifecycle_authority.py (a registered protected surface) and calling it from here.

The helper re-reads executor.state() (lock plus full-ledger deepcopy) even though _resume_decision_handoffs already read the same ledger at line 237. Passing that state in, or documenting that the fresher read is deliberate, avoids a redundant whole-ledger copy per staged handoff per tick.

lifecycle_state is compared without str(...).upper() and current_task_id without _nonblank normalization, unlike the transition_executor/ai_planner convention for the same fields. Current writers only emit normalized uppercase values and any mismatch fails closed, so this is consistency only.

The new e2e test reads planner.state()["plans"] unfiltered (the sibling test at line 2778 filters by project_id) and asserts neither the stale precondition (authority COMPLETE while agent/next.md is READY_TO_RUN at consumption time) nor the post-consumption authority state (current_task_id == P2, owner_gate None, one transition) that the sibling test pins. Adding those keeps the test anchored to the stale-readiness path if projection repair behavior changes later.

"Focused repair GREEN: nine tests" does not match the focused file, which collects eight (one identity test plus seven parametrized faults); nine is only reached by including the daemon-ordered e2e regression. Stating the split keeps the evidence record exact.
